offering_description.value: Distributes maintenance, repair and operating (MRO) products and provides related services to industrial customers. Also sells pumps, water and wastewater systems, and supply chain services. Sells through branches, service centers and direct sales teams.

primary_products.value: industrial MRO supplies; pumps and pump packages; bearings and power transmission products; safety products; water and wastewater equipment

primary_services.value: pump repair and fabrication; safety services; supply chain and inventory management; equipment maintenance and technical support

customer_segment.value: B2B: industrial, energy, construction, food and beverage and manufacturing customers; B2G: municipal water and wastewater utilities

end_markets.value: oil and gas; general industrial manufacturing; water and wastewater; food and beverage; construction; chemicals

revenue_model.value: product sales: MRO supplies, pumps, bearings, safety products and water equipment; service fees: repair, maintenance, safety services and supply chain management; project or contract: engineered pump packages and water system projects
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys MRO products from manufacturers, sells to industrial end users; service provider: repairs and maintains pumps and equipment, provides safety services; OEM / manufacturer: fabricates and packages pump systems from purchased components

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with some operations in other regions

specialization.value: related lines: MRO distribution, pumps and water systems, and supply chain services, all for industrial customers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: branches and service centers; direct sales: field sales teams and national accounts; online: e-commerce and procurement platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: workplace safety (OSHA), environmental rules, and trade and transport regulations

notes: Segment names and international footprint are from memory and may be slightly outdated.
